q: Why does our verifier want to compare production data with our GST returns?
title: Verifiers comparing production with GST
short: To check that the production figure behind your emissions intensity is real. Sales in GST returns, adjusted for stock changes, should roughly match production. A large gap suggests the intensity is wrong, so be ready to explain stock, rejects and job work.
audience: Indian manufacturers reporting emissions per tonne or per unit

ul: Quantity sold in GST returns or e-invoices.
Production reported in your intensity figure.
Job work done for others, which is not your sale.
Rejects and seconds sold under different codes.

p: Prepare a short reconciliation with the main differences explained. It also helps when a buyer asks why your intensity changed.

senseible: Senseible keeps each figure linked to its source document, emission factor and method version, so a verifier can trace a total back to the invoice.
